description: Twenty-five minutes, five off, four times, then a long one. Its timers reach you with a card; set one to wake you if the phone will be face down.
name: Pomodoro, four rounds

steps.description: One line. The rounds are cheap; deciding what they are for is the part that gets skipped.
steps.title: Write what the four rounds are for

steps.description: Twenty-five minutes on that one thing. Anything else that comes up gets written down, not done.
steps.title: Focus

steps.description: Away from it. The round after a break you skipped is the round that goes badly.
steps.title: Five off

steps.description: Fifteen minutes, and away from the desk for them.
steps.title: The long one
